headline_seed: ‘Too lazy to do the job’: Democrats dump on Fetterman after WSJ report - Politico
draft_text:
The WSJ reports Sen. John Fetterman, 57, skipped a funeral for three Pa. police officers and canceled on paralyzed veterans — then came in to do a Fox News interview. Politico and People.com both covered the fallout.

And that's the mews.
